_meta.note: Every parameter has value, sourceUrl, verifiedBy (name) and verifiedOn (YYYY-MM-DD). All stay null until Elias verifies them against AADE / the law text. Never fill in estimates. 'description' is documentation only.

brackets.description: Income tax scale for employment income, tax year 2026. Expected shape: [{ "upTo": number | null, "rate": number }], upTo in EUR of taxable income per year (null = no upper limit), rate as a fraction (0.22 = 22%).

baseAmountByChildren.description: Employee tax reduction (μείωση φόρου) in EUR by number of dependent children. Expected shape: { "0": number, "1": number, ... } plus how to handle more children than listed.

phaseOutThreshold.description: Taxable income in EUR above which the tax reduction starts to shrink (and whether it differs by number of children).

phaseOutRate.description: How fast the tax reduction shrinks above the threshold, e.g. EUR per EUR 1,000 of income above it.

employeeRate.description: EFKA employee social contribution rate as a fraction of gross pay (total of all employee contributions; list the components in the source note if they differ).

monthlyInsurableCeiling.description: Monthly insurable-earnings ceiling in EUR above which no employee contributions are due.

appliesToEmploymentIncome.description: true / false: whether the special solidarity contribution applies to employment income in tax year 2026.

brackets.description: Solidarity contribution scale, same shape as incomeTax.brackets. If it does not apply, set to [] (still with source and verification).

salaryPaymentsPerYear.description: Number of salary payments per year for private-sector employees (expected 14; verify).

exemptionRate.description: Share of the covered income exempted under Article 5C, as a fraction (expected 0.5; verify).

exemptionAppliesTo.description: Which items the exemption reduces. Expected shape: list drawn from ["incomeTax", "solidarityContribution", "socialContributions"]. Expected: not social contributions; verify.

taxReductionInteraction.description: How the employee tax reduction interacts with 5C: whether it is computed on the reduced taxable amount or some other way. Free text until the mechanics are confirmed; M2 turns it into an enum.

durationYears.description: Number of tax years the 5C exemption applies for.

lookbackYears.description: Quiz Q1: length of the look-back window in years for prior Greek tax residence. OPEN ITEM: sources conflict (8 vs 5).

requiredNonResidentYears.description: Quiz Q1: years within the look-back window the person must NOT have been Greek tax resident. OPEN ITEM: sources conflict (7 of 8 vs 5).

minimumStayYears.description: Quiz Q4: minimum years the person must stay in Greece (expected 2; verify).

GB.description: true / false: the United Kingdom meets the administrative-cooperation condition for 5C.

US.description: true / false: the United States meets the administrative-cooperation condition for 5C.

AU.description: true / false: Australia meets the administrative-cooperation condition for 5C.
